meta.title: Soul Star — personal star from your date of birth
meta.description: Calculate your five-pointed star from your birth date and unlock spheres in sequence.

landing.title: A map of your unique energy
landing.lead: Enter your date of birth — the system builds your star from five spheres and the Soul Mission at the centre. The first sphere opens immediately; the rest unfold in order.
landing.invalid: Please check the date of birth.
landing.hint: The calculation takes a second. The first sphere — Personality — is available immediately.

starPage.title: A map of your unique energy
starPage.lead: The star has five spheres and the Soul Mission at the centre. Spheres unlock in sequence: each next one opens after the previous.
starPage.clickHint: Click a point inside the star to read its meaning in this sphere.
starPage.tapHint: Tap a sphere or a point
starPage.tapTriangle: Tap a corner of the triangle to read that point
starPage.soulMissionLead: All five spheres are open. The centre of the star is now available to read.
starPage.soulMissionPurpose: The central number of your star — the outcome of all five spheres.
starPage.needLogin: Leave your email to unlock the sphere — we will attach this star to it.
starPage.checkoutError: Could not start checkout. Please try again.
starPage.saveBanner: Save this star to your profile so it is not lost.
starPage.patternsLead: If a number appears more than once on the star, or a defined combination is present, a separate reading appears here. The author of the method fills in the texts.
starPage.patternLockedHint: This reading opens once the related spheres are unlocked.

points.clickRead: Click to read this value in {name}
points.samePoint: The same point also belongs to «{name}». Switch the tab above to read it there.
points.samePointLocked: The same point also belongs to «{name}». Its meaning there is different and opens with that sphere.
points.leadIn: In {name} this number is read as follows:

offer.missionLocked: The Soul mission sits at the centre and opens last, once all five spheres are unlocked.
offer.emailTitle: Where should we save the reading
offer.emailLead: Leave your email — we attach this star to an account and send access after payment. No password needed now.
offer.emailRequired: Enter an email to unlock the sphere.
offer.passwordLead: This email already has an account. Enter the password to continue to payment.
offer.blockedAccount: This account is blocked. Checkout is unavailable.

auth.name: Name
auth.blocked: This account is blocked. Contact support if this is a mistake.
auth.resetHint: We will send a link if the account exists.
auth.resetSent: If the account exists, the email is on its way.
auth.passwordChanged: Password updated. Log in with the new password.

account.title: Your account
account.starsLead: An account can hold several stars. Open the one you need — each card shows which spheres are already unlocked.
account.createHint: For a partner, a child or someone close
account.noteCreate: The Personality sphere opens free right after the star is built.
account.noteEdit: If you change the date of birth the star is recalculated. Unlocked spheres stay.
account.errDate: Check the date of birth: DD.MM.YYYY
account.toastCreated: Star built. The Personality sphere is open
account.toastRecalc: Star recalculated for the new date
account.checkoutError: Could not start checkout. Try again.
account.supportBody: Write to us — we reply within a day. Include your account email and the star date if the question is about a reading.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.mockLead: Test payment (mock). In production this is Stripe or YooKassa / SBP.
checkout.success: Payment received. The sphere is open.
checkout.loginRequired: Log in to buy a sphere.

admin.title: Admin
admin.lead: People first — that is where support questions land. Readings, prices and formulas live in the other tabs.
admin.usersLead: Find a person by email or name. Their card holds email, access, stars and payments.
admin.personLead: Email is the account key. A block stops login and payment; stars stay.
admin.starsLead: Granting a sphere is the same as a paid unlock. Reset leaves only the free Personality sphere.
admin.name: Name
admin.blockHint: A blocked person cannot log in or pay. Calculations and purchases are kept.
admin.confirmBlock: Block this person? They will not be able to log in or pay.
admin.notice_err_taken: That email belongs to another account.
admin.notice_err_self: You cannot block your own account.
admin.notice_err_last_admin: You cannot block the last admin.
admin.contentLead: Pick a sphere, then a point on the star. Inside are 22 {arcana}. Write in plain text: a blank line starts a new paragraph.
admin.contentAutoNote: Saving in one language auto-translates the others. A locale you already edited by hand is left alone — manual edits win.
admin.contentEmpty: No texts for this point yet.
admin.pricesLead: Unlock order first, then prices. Names match the star.
admin.orderLead: Drag a row or use the arrows. The top sphere unlocks first.
admin.pricesHint: Amount in rubles. A free sphere opens without payment.
admin.formulaLead: This is where the star is assembled. Personality, spirituality and money come from the date. The other points are sums of earlier ones.
admin.formulaExisting: Stars already calculated stay as they are. The new formula applies only to new calculations.
admin.formulaSaved: Saved. New calculations use this formula.
admin.formulaTestLead: Book control example: 05.03.1992 → 5 / 3 / 21 / 11 / 4 / 8. Uses the formula on screen, even before saving.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page does not exist — or the star belongs to another account.
